column1: # NFKC data for basic.rs, from Python 3.14.4 unicodedata (Unicode 16.0.0), generated by scripts/gen_basic.py
# d <code point> <code points...> is a character's full compatibility decomposition. Hangul syllables are computed
# k <first>[-<last>] <class> is the canonical combining class of a run, 0 elsewhere
# p <first> <second> <composite> is a canonical composition. Hangul syllables are computed
